explanation: Resume secure from the acknowledged frame-156 open, empty-hand retreat without replaying it or the stalled central descent. Add two independently reviewed observation actions: an upward clearance move and an elevated lateral/oblique wrist view. Preserve the old failed-pose operands. Assess a different grasp station shifted at most 20 mm toward the exposed end using current opposing sidewall samples and a quality-checked local upper segment. Do not reconstruct hidden corners or infer the earlier stall cause. Current local heights replace the historical global height bound only for this observed contact segment. Preserve the uncertainty guard, 3 mm guarded counter clearance, 5 mm guarded overlap, 7 mm nominal overlap floor, minimum feasible interval and controller tolerance choices. Only a supported candidate enters the existing separately reviewed approach, closure and differential retention sequence. Obstructions, missing measurements, failed margins and stalls stop with diagnostics, not unchanged retries.
interface: Exact replacements modify main(api) for secure only. Outcomes contain stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. New secure.view preserves entry state and the prior failed pose, records observation-motion intent before dispatch and actual states afterward, and stores current review frames, points/errors, local plane quality, derived upper-edge samples, sidewall operands, thresholds and margins. Existing secure.view prevents automatic replay. secure.stall remains the historical acknowledged retreat. secure.geometry gains local_surface_frame, local_surface_checkpoint and grasp_station_shift_m; its historical footprint and current local height provenance remain distinct. Existing candidate, pose_gate, progress, failure, baseline, tracker, test and retention records are retained. Handoff lists checkpoint keys and actual state in world meters/tool-to-world xyzw. Observation motion is not grasp evidence. No transport or release code is added.
jev_protocol: Preserve seven questions: x/y/z select negative/hold/positive from their explicitly named world translation goal_relation; rx/ry/rz do likewise for world rotation-vector components. Gripper open/close/keep follows objective.gripper unchanged. Jev receives program-labelled phase, target and guard plus host proprioception/residuals; it does not measure geometry or infer contact/retention. All motion uses api.drive or api.control. Observation rise and lateral tilt retain open actuation, use 2.5 mm position and 0.01 rad orientation tolerances, 8 mm translation limits and finite caps of 28 and 34 calls with reserves. A measured-height/own-finger rotation bound gates tilt; a separate current review gates other-obstacle clearance. Unknown later grasp conditions do not veto an independently supported observation move. Whole-lease state comparisons distinguish progressing lease_exhausted from stalls and ineffective corrections. Slice boundaries do not cause yield. The different contact candidate must pass unchanged feasible-height and actual-pose margins and fresh approach/closure reviews. Never repeat a stalled descent, blindly reopen or infer retention from reached/closure. Completion still requires corresponding package motion versus actual hand motion and fresh held-clear-of-counter evidence. Tracking is replaceable by independent landmarks; their 5 mm spread screen is twice the 2.5 mm landmark guard, with additional motion-to-uncertainty tests, not a universal object-size requirement.
